Title: Generally Available: SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) 21

Body.Content:
For two decades, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) has been the primary tool for SQL database administrators and database developers. SSMS provides a powerful and user-friendly interface for managing SQL databases, writing T-SQL, and troubleshooting problems. With the release of SSMS 21, built on Visual Studio 2022, the platform continues to advance with 64-bit support, a modern installer, and automatic updates. This latest version introduces Git integration, initial dark theme support, and enhancements to the query editor, results grid, and Azure authentication. Whether supporting on-premises or cloud-based SQL environments, SSMS remains the trusted solution for efficient and effective database management. 

Learn more.
